summary: Master hedge fund strategies and pension fund management. Learn asset allocation, due diligence, and risk attribution from industry experts. Enroll today.
lede: Hedge fund and pension fund investment focuses on selecting strategies, allocating institutional assets, and managing portfolio risk against long-term liabilities. For trustees, analysts, consultants, risk officers, and portfolio managers, the training develops practical skills in comparing hedge fund strategies and conducting manager due diligence. Participants also practice portfolio stress testing, asset-allocation modeling, and performance attribution to support investment decisions and stakeholder reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for professionals who manage, advise, or oversee significant institutional capital and require a deep understanding of alternative investment vehicles.
modules: Institutional Investment Foundations and Market Dynamics
Hedge Fund Strategy Analysis and Execution
Pension Fund Mechanics and Liability-Driven Investment
Quantitative Risk Management and Stress Testing
Manager Selection and Operational Due Diligence
Portfolio Construction and Asset Allocation Modeling
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in finance, investment management, or institutional oversight. A working knowledge of basic statistical concepts (mean, standard deviation, correlation) and familiarity with Excel-based financial modeling is required. No prior programming or coding experience is necessary, as all quantitative exercises will be conducted using provided templates and standard financial tools.
